preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 4.
The size of the grid k must be between 1 and 15.
Each row must contain exactly 2k + 1 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, (int, str)) for x in row1 + row2)
preconditions.description: All elements in the rows must be either integers or the string 'E'.
There must be exactly one 'E' in the combined rows.

postconditions.description: The output must indicate whether the surgery is complete or failed.
If surgery is complete, the output must include a sequence of moves.

postconditions.expression: any(c in 'udlr' for c in stdout.splitlines()[1])
postconditions.description: The sequence of moves must consist of valid move characters.
The output must end with the string 'DONE'.
